items.exampleEn: The bank is at the end of the street.
She sets the cups on the table.

items.sentenceEn: We stand in line for the bus.

items.audioEn: What happened? Why did the train stop?
items.audioZh: 發生什麼事了？火車為什麼停了？

items.sentenceEn: Let's sit down and watch the movie.
Set the glasses on the table, please.

items.stemEn: Please ____ down. The class will begin.
Turn right at the ____ of this street.

items.passageEn: At the end of the school day, the bus stops near our school. Today, something happened. The bus did not come! We stood and waited for an hour. Then my dad came and brought us home. At home, we watched a movie together.
items.passageZh: 放學時，公車會停在我們學校附近。今天發生了一件事：公車沒有來！我們站著等了一個小時。後來我爸爸來把我們帶回家。在家裡，我們一起看了一部電影。

questions.questionZh: 今天放學時發生了什麼事？

rubricZh: 問發生了什麼可用 What happened? 或 What is happening? 等
happen 後面不接受詞（不說 What happened it?）

items.instructionZh: 用 bring 造一個句子，說說你明天要帶什麼。
referenceEn: I will bring my lunch tomorrow.
Tomorrow, I am going to bring a cake for my team.
rubricZh: bring 後面接帶的東西（例如 bring my lunch），帶給誰可用 for 或 to
明天的事用表示未來的寫法（例如 will、be going to）
